New test functions are named test_* and annotated -> None, consistent with tests/test_progress.py:54-531. Helpers _make_console and _make_temp_file are module-private.
The CHANGELOG entry sits in the Unreleased Added list (CHANGELOG.md:13), following the existing entry style.
Type-ignore comments on readinto and readline mirror reference.diff:155 and :288.
Text default mode 'r' returns io.TextIOWrapper (generated/rich/progress.py:1311-1320). 'rb' returns the binary reader (:1311-1312).

total defaults to os.stat(file).st_size (:1301-1302) and is computed before add_task (:1305), so a missing path raises FileNotFoundError without leaving a task. The test at tests/test_progress.py:613-622 asserts this.
wrap_file with no total and no task total raises ValueError (:1352-1354). Using task_id reuses the task total (:1346-1352), matching reference.diff:662-668.
Mode validation runs before any side effects (:1280-1282). buffering=0 in text mode raises (:1296), and buffering=1 in binary mode warns and resets buffering (:1287).
